# Pi → DSH 理论架构映射

本页是[映射标准](architecture-mapping-standard.md)的理论视图。每条 Pi 叶子接口先归入一个
能力契约，再由能力契约映射到 DSH 承载机制和具体公开 seam。接口清单、架构抽象与
理论映射因此可以双向下钻，而不是三张互不相干的表。

## Pi 能力契约与 DSH 承载机制

| Pi 能力契约 | 上游接口行 | DSH 承载机制 | 理论承载方式 | 预期公开 seam |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `pi.tools.registry`<br>工具注册与可见性 | 4 | `dsh.execution` | 直接承接 | ctx.tools registry and per-agent visibility |
| `pi.tools.lifecycle`<br>工具执行生命周期 | 5 | `dsh.execution`<br>`dsh.agent-session` | 组合承接 | tool execution lifecycle and durable tool events |
| `pi.tools.process-execution`<br>进程执行 | 2 | `dsh.execution` | 直接承接 | ctx.exec and subprocess provider |
| `pi.commands.registry`<br>命令注册 | 2 | `dsh.interaction` | 直接承接 | ctx.commands registry |
| `pi.commands.controls`<br>Flag 与快捷键 | 3 | `dsh.interaction`<br>`dsh.client` | 组合承接 | command descriptors and client input bindings |
| `pi.input.preprocess`<br>用户输入预处理 | 1 | `dsh.plugin-composition`<br>`dsh.agent-session` | 直接承接 | agent/pre-step before input becomes a durable step |
| `pi.messages.injection`<br>消息注入 | 2 | `dsh.agent-session`<br>`dsh.plugin-composition` | 组合承接 | agent/pre-step and native session message append |
| `pi.messages.lifecycle`<br>消息与上下文生命周期 | 4 | `dsh.agent-session`<br>`dsh.model-runtime` | 组合承接 | llm stream and pre-commit/durable message lifecycle |
| `pi.agent.lifecycle`<br>Agent 与轮次生命周期 | 6 | `dsh.plugin-composition`<br>`dsh.agent-session` | 组合承接 | agent waterfalls and durable turn/step events |
| `pi.agent.control`<br>Agent 控制与空闲状态 | 5 | `dsh.plugin-composition`<br>`dsh.orchestration` | 组合承接 | agent queue, cancellation signal and lifecycle |
| `pi.prompt.context`<br>提示词与上下文检查 | 3 | `dsh.model-runtime`<br>`dsh.agent-session` | 组合承接 | system-prompt/assemble, token-meter and session projection |
| `pi.sessions.metadata`<br>会话事实与元数据 | 7 | `dsh.agent-session`<br>`dsh.client` | 理论上缺公开 seam | namespaced durable session facts and native projection |
| `pi.sessions.navigation`<br>会话创建、分支与导航 | 8 | `dsh.agent-session`<br>`dsh.orchestration` | 组合承接 | ctx.sessions create/fork and host-wide navigation lifecycle |
| `pi.sessions.compaction`<br>会话压缩 | 3 | `dsh.agent-session`<br>`dsh.plugin-composition` | 理论上缺公开 seam | pre-compaction decision waterfall plus durable result events |
| `pi.sessions.host-context`<br>会话宿主上下文与重载 | 5 | `dsh.agent-session`<br>`dsh.plugin-composition` | 组合承接 | session service, workspace scope and Cordis reload |
| `pi.models.providers`<br>Provider 与模型目录 | 6 | `dsh.model-runtime`<br>`dsh.plugin-composition` | 组合承接 | llm catalog, llm.registerAdapter, credentials and settings |
| `pi.models.selection`<br>模型与推理档位选择 | 6 | `dsh.model-runtime`<br>`dsh.client` | 组合承接 | authoritative model catalog and request-level reasoning options |
| `pi.models.wire`<br>Provider 网络请求生命周期 | 3 | `dsh.model-runtime`<br>`dsh.plugin-composition` | 理论上缺公开 seam | adapter transport request/response middleware |
| `pi.ui.questions`<br>阻塞式用户提问 | 5 | `dsh.interaction`<br>`dsh.client` | 组合承接 | ctx.userQuestions with native client rendering |
| `pi.ui.notifications`<br>通知与工作状态 | 7 | `dsh.client` | 组合承接 | client module and shell slots |
| `pi.ui.chrome`<br>宿主框架与工具展开状态 | 5 | `dsh.client` | 组合承接 | client slot registry and host-owned presentation state |
| `pi.ui.editor`<br>编辑器交互 | 7 | `dsh.client`<br>`dsh.interaction` | 宿主语义翻译 | client editor slots and command/input bridge |
| `pi.ui.rendering`<br>消息渲染与主题 | 8 | `dsh.client` | 宿主语义翻译 | Web-native client modules and slots |
| `pi.project.trust`<br>项目信任 | 2 | `dsh.plugin-composition`<br>`dsh.resources` | 理论上缺公开 seam | host-owned trust policy before project resource loading |
| `pi.resources.discovery`<br>动态资源发现 | 1 | `dsh.resources`<br>`dsh.plugin-composition` | 组合承接 | lifecycle-bound skill/MCP/resource providers |
| `pi.events.bus`<br>包内事件总线 | 1 | `dsh.plugin-composition` | 直接承接 | package-scoped event bus disposed with the plugin fiber |

## DSH 承载机制与 45 个子系统

| DSH 承载机制 | 子系统 | 公开机制示例 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh.plugin-composition`<br>插件组合与策略 | `core`、`extensions`、`settings`、`scope`、`invariants`、`permission-presets` | Cordis service/provider<br>ctx.effect<br>ctx.inject<br>waterfall<br>scope/isolate/intercept |
| `dsh.agent-session`<br>持久会话与上下文投影 | `compaction`、`persistence`、`session-projection`、`session-query`、`session-reference`、`session-telemetry`、`session-title`、`session`、`spill`、`storage` | ctx.sessions<br>Session.append<br>durable session events<br>compaction<br>session projection |
| `dsh.model-runtime`<br>模型路由、凭证与提示词装配 | `credentials`、`llm-streaming`、`token-meter`、`system-prompt` | llm.registerAdapter<br>llm/stream<br>credentials provider<br>system-prompt/assemble<br>agent/request |
| `dsh.execution`<br>工具、执行与隔离 | `approval`、`code-runtime`、`filesystem`、`sandbox`、`shell`、`subprocess`、`terminal`、`tools` | ctx.tools<br>ctx.exec<br>subprocess provider<br>sandbox provider<br>approval policy |
| `dsh.resources`<br>工作区资源 | `attachment`、`skills`、`web`、`workspace`、`lsp` | attachment provider<br>skill provider<br>web provider<br>workspace provider<br>lsp provider |
| `dsh.orchestration`<br>Agent 编排 | `goal`、`jobs`、`plan`、`schedule`、`subagent`、`workflow` | ctx.agents<br>subagent provider<br>goal/plan/jobs/workflow providers |
| `dsh.interaction`<br>命令与人机交互 | `commands`、`feedback`、`user-questions` | ctx.commands<br>ctx.userQuestions<br>feedback provider |
| `dsh.client`<br>客户端与 Web 呈现 | `client-modules`、`typert`、`web-server` | client module<br>slot registry<br>web route<br>typert remote surface |

完整性约束由文档生成检查强制执行：每条运行时 Pi surface 恰好属于一个能力契约；每个
能力契约恰好有一条理论映射；官方 45 个 DSH 子系统恰好属于一个承载机制。任何新增、
遗漏、重复或陈旧条目都会让 `pnpm check:docs` 失败。
